read: SELECT through the Supabase MCP on 2026-09-30: 77 rows, one per season 1949 to 2025, no duplicate years, no constraints, RLS on.

columns.year: shown (List Quiz answer set, NASCAR Chain validator, Guess The NASCAR Driver clue text)
columns.team: shown in the Guess The NASCAR Driver "Title car" clue, via scripts/genNascarDrivers.mjs
columns.wins_that_season: not read by any file in src, supabase or scripts; checked anyway because the table asserts it
columns.points: NULL on every row and read by nothing; left NULL, not filled
columns.car_number: the table has no car number column and no reader shows one, so there is nothing to verify

nascar_com_list.gives: champion, manufacturer and wins for 1949 to 2023 (last updated after the 2023 season)

nascar_com_2024.gives: Joey Logano, No. 22 Team Penske Ford, four wins

nascar_com_2025.gives: Kyle Larson, No. 5 Hendrick Motorsports Chevrolet, 3 wins

racing_reference_table.gives: champion and car owner for every season

racing_reference_seasons.gives: every start of the champion that season: owner, make, finish (wins counted from finishes of 1, which equals the page's own Win total on all 77 pages)

fox_sports.gives: champion and team for 1949 to 2024 (a second, independent team source; it has two errors, see 2002, 2005, 1955, 1956)

espn.gives: champion names only, 1949 to 2025; agrees with every driver_name

sources.independence: Racing Reference is part of the NASCAR Digital Media network, so for driver, manufacturer and wins nascar.com and Racing Reference are two datasets from one owner. ESPN (drivers) and Fox Sports (teams) are the independent cross checks.

team_convention: The column mixes car owner names (Rick Hendrick, Joe Gibbs, Roger Penske) and team names (Joe Gibbs Racing, Team Penske, Stewart-Haas Racing, Furniture Row). Both are true of the same organisation and this round keeps the stored form wherever it is true; only a spelling found in neither source was corrected.

fingerprint.how: md5 of the rows ordered by year, each row year|driver_name|team|manufacturer|wins_that_season|points with NULL written as ~, joined by a newline (the same expression the migration evaluates)
